answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital commitment, acting like an onyx fortress against identity fabrication. An attacker attempting to flood the lagoon of agents with fake nodes incurs a prohibitive cost, as they must acquire a majority of the network value—a task as futile as cracking a walnut shell with a feather. This economic barrier ensures that identity is tethered to verifiable, scarce assets rather than ephemeral compute.
